四级核心词汇 · 03英文原文

The Gate in the Orchard Fence

果园围栏上的那道门 · 598 词 · 8 段 · 首次出现的目标词加粗

1A drought had left the soil hard on a rural estate and hindered root development. A shallow basin held the first rain. The peach trees might bear more fruit and the corn might thrive. Then a row of young plants turned pale while dense weeds spread. Bo, an apprentice in agriculture, saw tracks beside a broken fence. He blamed a goat and asked the owner to block every gap before it could destroy the crop.

2His grandmother asked him to compare the damaged row with a healthy one. There were hoof marks but no bite on the leaves. The roots felt moist. The owner had combined organic fertilizer with a mineral compound to stimulate growth, then watered the whole field through one pipe. Bo dug a hole and found coarse clay beneath a thin layer of dirt. Rain had penetrated the surface but could not drain through the clay.

3A farmer from the next plantation showed him how to test moisture with a stick. Wheat could grow in fertile soil, whereas young peaches needed ample air at their roots. Bo set up two plots to analyze the problem. He increased the depth of the ditch in one and gave the other less water. He used colored labels to classify the seeds and drew a rough outline of each plot. Others could therefore reproduce the layout.

4A flock of geese that migrated along the coast landed in the basin. A teacher asked her pupils to observe the species that fed there. They found a worm in the mud and an insect on a pine branch. The basin had become a habitat during the drought. Bo's original solution would have drained the marsh. He devised a way to divert orchard water around the basin, irrigate the upper plot at short intervals, and leave a strip of bush by the shore.

5The owner thought the scheme would cost too much. Bo calculated the length of pipe. A wooden fork in the fence could support it. Gravity would move water down a slight incline, so no new pump was necessary. The owner postponed a major purchase and agreed to a trial. By the end of the week, less water reached the clay. Bo photographed a new leaf to document the gradual recovery.

6A neighbor warned that rats might breed among leaves scattered in the ditch. Bo cleared the leaves and marked the rise in water after the next shower. The gap in the fence had once allowed a bunch of weeds to catch trash from the road. A small grate kept it from entering the pipe. The owner saw that it was indispensable to regulate drainage, even on dry ground.

7A frost then threatened the harvest. Bo covered the delicate plants and noted which were resistant. The owner wanted to pick every peach before the cold. Bo fetched two baskets for the ripe fruit. The rest needed another week to mature. In the morning the cover was damp, but the trees had not suffered severe damage. The new system could sustain their crop without sacrificing the water the birds used.

8Bo mended the fence and left a gate wide enough for a cart. The owner wondered whether the goat would return. Bo said the tracks had made him overlook the real problem. He hung a note asking people to keep the gate shut and report where water gathered. In spring an occasional goose still wandered in. The birds tended to follow water. Farmers could guide them out. The more fruitful habit was to look at the ground before they blamed the animal.

四级核心词汇 · 03中文译文

果园围栏上的那道门

按英文段落顺序对照阅读

1一场干旱让乡下果园的土变硬，根系很难生长。第一场雨积在浅洼地里。桃树本来有望多结些果，玉米也可能长旺，偏偏有一排幼株发白，杂草倒越长越密。学种植的小博在坏掉的围栏旁看到足迹，怪是一只山羊闯了进来。他请园主把缺口堵严，免得山羊毁掉庄稼。

2祖母请他把受损的一排和健康的一排放在一起看。地上有蹄印，叶片上却没有咬过的痕迹，根还是湿的。园主为了促进生长，把有机肥和一种矿物化合物混着用，又用一根管子给整片地浇水。小博挖了一个坑，薄薄的表土下面是一层粗黏土。雨水透过地表，却排不过这层黏土。

3隔壁种植园的农人教他用木棍查看土壤湿度。小麦可以长在肥土里，幼桃树的根却还需要足够的空气。小博划出两小块地来查原因。他挖深其中一块的沟，另一块少浇一点水。他用彩色标签给种子分类，也画了每块地的大致形状，这样别人就能照着布置。

4一群沿海岸迁徙的鹅落到洼地里。一位老师请学生观察在这里觅食的物种。他们在泥里找到一条虫，又在松枝上看到一只昆虫。干旱期间，这片洼地成了动物的栖息地。按小博原来的做法，湿地会被排干。他重新想了个办法，把果园的水引得绕开洼地，隔一小段时间给地势较高的一块地浇水，再把水边的一条灌木留住。

5园主觉得这个办法太贵。小博算了需要多长的管子，发现可以用围栏上的一截分叉木头来架管。借着一点坡度，水靠重力就能往下走，用不着买新泵。园主把一笔大开支往后推，同意先试一试。到周末，流到黏土上的水少了。小博拍下一片新叶，记录植株慢慢恢复的过程。

6一位邻居提醒，沟里散落的叶子可能招老鼠在那儿繁殖。小博把叶子清掉，在下一场阵雨过后标出涨水的位置。过去，围栏缺口旁的一丛杂草总拦住从路上飘来的垃圾。装上一道小格栅，就能挡住垃圾，不让它进管子。园主这才看出，即使地面看起来干，管好排水也少不了。

7接着一场霜威胁到了收成。小博盖住娇嫩的植株，记下哪些耐寒。园主想在降温前把桃子全部摘下来。小博提来两个篮子，先装熟透的果子。剩下的还要一周才熟。早上盖布湿了，桃树却没有受到严重损伤。新办法保住了作物，也留下了鸟需要的水。

8小博补好围栏，又留了一道能让小车通过的门。园主问山羊会不会回来。小博说，蹄印曾让他漏看了真正的问题。他在门上挂了张纸，请大家把门关好，发现哪里积水就说一声。到了春天，偶尔还是有鹅走进来。鸟往往顺着水走，农人也能把它们领出去。后来大家养成了一个更管用的习惯，先看地上发生了什么，再决定该不该怪动物。
